Windows 95, in CSS

June 2013 · Web experiments

My attempt to recreate the Windows 95 launch animation in CSS.

Dates & sources

The original Git history begins on 4 June 2013.

Play the animation ↗Source ↗Archived site · 12 June 2013 ↗

I recreated the Windows 95 launch animation with four colored squares and CSS. It’s a small experiment in what you can do with keyframes and transforms.

The restored demo has a pause button and respects reduced-motion preferences.
